explicit_limits: Acceptance CAS occurs after the earlier power protocol event; a delayed PM hook remains a real gap, and the fixed event deadline is preserved.
A zero commit snapshot does not prove closed ingress, whole CPU-producer quiescence, PCIe posted-write drain, device/firmware stop or a PM acknowledgement.
Endpoint duration, arbitrary callback/OOM recursion, scheduling and complete original unwind remain unbounded.
This adds real frames and calls; no aggregate kernel stack or target capacity proof is established.
